title: Decoupled Divergence-Free Neural Networks Basis Method for Incompressible Fluid Problems
summary: We propose a decoupled divergence-free neural networks basis (Decoupled-DFNN) method for solving incompressible flow problems, including the Stokes and Navier-Stokes equations. To ensure the divergence free property exactly, the velocity field is represented as the curl of a stream function in two dimensions and as the curl of a vector potential in three dimensions.
